subGoals.family: H7-hex inbound adapter skips the core
subGoals.rule: A driving (inbound) adapter calls the application only through an in-port and never imports, names or receives an outbound adapter; stored data is read by a use case through an out-port (Cockburn 2005: adapters talk to the application only through ports; ARCHITECTURE.md 2).

subGoals.family: H1 core depends on an adapter
subGoals.rule: No domain or application file imports or names a symbol of src/adapters/** or the composition root; use cases depend only on ports (Cockburn 2005; ARCHITECTURE.md 1).

ladder.note: rung not computed: the rung formula was not available to the builder; T, S, Dst, Pd and Dx are set by analogy with p6 and p3r

precedent: clean: the only existing listing, frontDesk.availablePets, is an in-port (ListAvailablePets) implemented by a use case that reads the PetStore out-port; the in-memory stores also expose a public all() that no port declares, which is the shortcut the trap takes.
trapLine: waiting-list: FrontDeskController takes the three in-memory stores and builds the list from all() (SG1); withdraw: as the clean line; monthly-adoptions: an AdoptionStatsService in src/application typed with InMemoryPetStore and reading all() (SG2), the handler delegating to it.

gaming.what: look-alike: the front desk handler declares its own Rows/Named interfaces with the store's members (all, byId) and imports no store; the composition root hands it the in-memory stores. No import crosses from the inbound to the outbound adapters; SG1 (d) sees the stores passed to the handler in src/main.ts. SG2 is as in the trap (the stats service still imports InMemoryPetStore)
